game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Lantern Path Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Lantern Path, a lantern-lit path: the herbalist must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Lantern Path: a lantern-lit path
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Path, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the mushroom ring using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The mushroom ring reached with actions_used <= 23.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the mushroom ring is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Roll Call Enumerate' (Week 5 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Lantern Path'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how roll_call changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous sprites in Lantern Path.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The mushroom ring reached with actions_used <= 23.
